subject: expression: expose some basic fields to `expression.EvalContext` (#51420)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent (7b558417bec7ac246134af5f112e90651cab5bab) in `pkg/expression/*`, `pkg/executor/*`, `pkg/table/*`. Change is an API expansion/refactor: `expression/context.EvalContext` gains basic accessors (`CtxID`, `TypeCtx`, `ErrCtx`, `Location`, warning ops, `CurrentDB`, `GetMaxAllowedPacket`, `GetDefaultWeekFormatMode`) with a session-backed implementation (`pkg/expression/contextimpl/sessionctx.go`), and call sites switch from reaching into `SessionVars/StmtCtx` to these accessors (aggregation distinct checker, vec group checker key encoding, group_concat comparisons/truncation, partition locate conversions, builtins using current DB/max_allowed_packet/default_week_format, builtin cache keyed by ctx id). Semantics appear preserved: timezone/error-handling still comes from statement type/err context, and max_allowed_packet now uses the validated `SessionVars.MaxAllowedPacket` field instead of reparsing a sysvar string.
